key: # M18: the tone, the sign rule and the report flag of each event kind (engine_report.cpp). A text provider of the front end uses them to write a line.

# The player decided on 2026-10-20 (spec DECISIONS.md) that the tone, the personality and the sign of an event matter more than the exact words. The spec has no list of tones, so every row is assumed.
# tone: neutral, calm, proud, joyful, worried, alarmed, grim, angry, humble. sign: amount (good if the amount rises), good, bad, neutral.
# log: no for a side effect of a command (its cost, merit, technique points and losses). The original log shows one line for the main effect of a command (ui/clone-gap-report.md, section 4).
# report: yes if the turn start of the faction shows the event in the message window. The log keeps every event. A kind without a row: tone neutral, sign amount, no report.

note: the order of a build; the bubble of the command shows it
